#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# Simple endpoint health monitor.
# Checks the app's HTTP endpoints and reports status + latency.
# Does NOT read, export, or transmit any credentials/secrets.

set -euo pipefail

BASE_URL="${BASE_URL:-http://localhost:3000}"
ENDPOINTS=("/health" "/users")

timestamp() { date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"; }

check() {
  local path="$1"
  local url="${BASE_URL}${path}"

  # -o /dev/null: discard body, -w: write status + total time
  local result
  result=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}" "$url" || echo "000 0")

  local code="${result%% *}"
  local time="${result##* }"

  if [[ "$code" == "200" ]]; then
    echo "$(timestamp) OK   $path  code=$code  time=${time}s"
  else
    echo "$(timestamp) FAIL $path  code=$code  time=${time}s" >&2
  fi
}

main() {
  echo "$(timestamp) Monitoring ${BASE_URL}"
  for ep in "${ENDPOINTS[@]}"; do
    check "$ep"
  done
}

main "$@"
